<description>
After #35531, each txindex entry now points to the block hash containing the tx instead of the file location of the block. The block hash is then used to find the file position of the block to read the tx from. This allows us to determine the hash of the containing block even if the block is later pruned, and also determine the location of the block on disk if it is later downloaded again via `getblockfrompeer`.

This PR enables maintaining a txindex while pruned. If a txid lookup tries to read a tx from a pruned block, the hash of the missing block is surfaced to the caller.

If desired, a user may call `getblockfrompeer` using the returned hash to download the block, then try again successfully. The downloaded block will be added to the front of the block queue, so won't be pruned again for at least 288 blocks. Of course a larger prune setting is desired if lots of historical blocks will be read, and there are privacy issues if the user is looking up their own transactions. Ideally the blocks can be fetched from a trusted node or from random peers with decoy blocks fetched occasionally.

Resolves https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/10609, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/12651, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/16182, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/35240
</description>

[2026-09-29] c:5899992071 comment by optout21 (contributor):
Concept ACK

The ability to have a txindex holding information of _all_ transactions even in case of a pruned node is a huge improvement, it makes pruned nodes much more capable.

I agree that the space concern due to "full" txindex in case of a pruned node is secondary for now, and can be addressed later. A pruned txindex containing only TXs from the non-pruned blocks is of limited use in general, I would say.

I'm a bit concerned that the interplay of different dimensions could lead to a complexity explosion. To limit that, some combinations have to be excluded outright. This is outside of the scope of this PR, but it's good to have in sight.

Just so far these dimensions have been mentioned:
- blocks full or pruned
- txindex enabled or not
- txindex enabled before/with block pruning or after
- txindex contains legacy keys or not
- txindex is wished to be full or pruned.
